messages.text:
"Make FR Legends but a singleplayer and multiplayer NASCAR racing game with FR Legends graphics like 3D Cartoon outlines with plain colored textures and a little low poly car models, and crash physics with mesh deformation using joints or nodes and beams. The singleplayer will have a randomized decal AI option to race with a little of 14 with an option to change NASCAR models of both player and ai racers (Gen 4, Gen 5, Gen 6, and Next Gen). The multiplayer will have a lobby of server with an option to choose a server with each NASCAR models (Gen 4, Gen 5, Gen 6, and Next Gen) with a limit of 15 players and 100 spectators. Also has a Settings button to change graphics, sensitivity and stuff. And a garage to customize decals to your NASCAR models (Gen 4, Gen 5, Gen 6, and Next Gen). The game is called Stock Legends.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"
